summary: Verified MedMatch branding, removal of AI wording, Care Need panel, order-of-flow, voice buttons on SOS/help/ASHA, hospital search page, and @medmatch.in demo credentials. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed (service='MedMatch', SOS triage returns urgency+facilities, chest pain -> urgent+cardiology+ECG/Cath Lab/Emergency Care, Hindi 'सीने में दर्द' same result, skin -> non-urgent+dermatology, all 3 demo logins successful, /api/hospitals returns >=3 seeds with Jaipur & 2+ cardiology). Frontend: title correct, brand-tagline visible, no 'Sanjeevani'/'RuralCare'/standalone 'AI'/'एआई' on Landing (EN+HI), Login, SOS, /me, Hospitals, ASHA create-patient, hospital dashboard. Login demo buttons show @medmatch.in. SOS shows no care-need-card/results until submission; after chest pain submit shows care-urgency=Urgent, care-specialty=Cardiologist, care-facilities=Emergency Care/ECG/Cath Lab, then 'Best Matching Hospitals' heading. sos-voice-button present, click did not crash. Patient /me/:id/help: no care-need-card before submit, problem-text-input + voice button both present, after Find hospital -> Urgent+Cardiologist. Hospital search: 'cardio'->2, 'Jaipur'->1, empty search shows all, 'zzzznotfound' -> 'No hospitals found'. nav-hospital-search-link visible for both patient and ASHA. asha-voice-button present on /asha/patients/new and click did not crash. Hospital login lands on /hospital dashboard OK.
